name: Envelope card reveal
what: A dark envelope slides up into a warm-lit dark scene, grows and settles, flips its flap open on a black inside, and a card - your picture or video, with a label - slides up out of it.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f13-f29 a small closed envelope slides up from the bottom (S-curve); f29-f34 it waits; f34-f68 it grows x1.6 and settles lower (S-curve); f66-f71 its flap flips open (through edge-on) on a black inside; f72-f97 the card slides up out of the pocket (slow start, fast middle, long soft finish, its lower corners cut by the front flaps); then it holds

tracks.name: envelope rise
tracks.what: a small closed envelope slides up from the bottom of the frame

tracks.name: envelope grow
tracks.what: it grows x1.6 and settles lower in the frame

tracks.name: flap
tracks.what: the flap flips open (through edge-on) on a black inside

tracks.name: card
tracks.what: the card slides up out of the pocket and stops
tracks.easing: slow start, fast middle, long soft end
